ns2:section.sectionText: This is the international immersion trip to India over Spring Break that will involve field research in urban, semi-urban, and rural South India. You must complete an application process to register for this course. Students may not receive credit for this course and BADM 532 and/or BADM 533. Please contact Kelly O'Neill koneill2@illinois.edu or Nadine Gleason nlin2@illinois.edu if you are interested.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MBA: (PT) Business Adm -- UIUC or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
